text:
Jules (Finance): Recon job flagged 47 Stripe payments marked succeeded but no corresponding NetSuite invoices. Noticed this at 01:46 UTC. Can payments/ops look?

Amir (Payments): Checking Stripe -> looks like a delivery failure pattern to /webhooks/netsuite around 01:40-01:50 UTC. Did we change webhook handling recently?

billing-bot: ALERT: webhook-delivery spike for /webhooks/netsuite 01:39:12 - 01:51:58 UTC. Failed events: 46. Error types: 38 x SignatureVerificationError, 8 x UpstreamHTTP(500). Incident ref: /ops/webhooks/alerts/1742408800

Kai (Backend): We rotated NETSUITE_WEBHOOK_SECRET during the 01:30 UTC deploy and tightened timestamp tolerance to 300s. Logs show many rejects with "SignatureVerificationError: timestamp outside tolerance" after rotation.

Rosa (Ops): I deployed the secret rotation. Stripe has a separate signing secret for the endpoint; apparently the rotation left Stripe's endpoint configured with the old secret. Re-applying old secret to verifier now and will restart billing-sync.

Kai (Backend): Adding a short-term fallback to accept previous secret for 6h and changing create retry behavior: treat NetSuite 409 (externalId exists) as idempotent -> fetch existing record instead of retrying create. Preparing hotfix.

billing-bot: DEPLOYMENT: billing-sync v2.15.1-hotfix deployed by Kai at 01:58 UTC. Health checks passing.

Amir (Payments): Example event: evt_2LAbcXyz - invoice.payment_succeeded, metadata.external_invoice_ref="INV-2026-03-24-42". Pushed sample to backfill queue. Also saw partial create traces in logs for some retries.

Rosa (Ops): Opened NetSuite ticket NS-9911 for partial create cleanup and to ensure external_id locks are available while we retry. Requested they clear any partial records for the listed external_ids.

Jules (Finance): Please export exceptions CSV (stripe_event, external_invoice_ref, customer_email, amount, currency, stripe_status) for CS. We need to notify customers with missing PDFs.

Amir (Payments): CSV generated: /finance/recon/ops/1742408800-missing_invoices.csv. Backfill queued but holding until NetSuite confirms partials cleared.

Kai (Backend): Patch in prod. Also increased logging of raw Stripe signature header for audit. I'll update runbook: 1) keep previous secret for 24h fallback, 2) pre-rotation checklist to update Stripe endpoint secret via API if possible, 3) change 409 handling to idempotent.

billing-bot: JOB: recon-backfill queued (job_id=rb-1742408800-1).

Rosa (Ops): NetSuite responded: will clear 7 partial records within 2 hours and asked us to pause automated retries until cleared. Case NS-9911 updated.

Amir (Payments): Running manual backfill at 02:17 UTC after confirm. Dedupe by stripe_event and external_invoice_ref before create.

billing-bot: BACKFILL-PROGRESS: processed=46, created=39, fetched_existing=0, blocked=7 (waiting NetSuite cleanup). Detailed CSV: /finance/recon/ops/1742408800-missing_invoices.csv

Jules (Finance): Impact summary for postmortem: 46 events affected, 39 invoices created after backfill, 7 pending; payments were captured in Stripe for all events; CS notified with CSV. Please include root cause and remediation steps in postmortem.

Kai (Backend): Will draft postmortem. Immediate actions: (a) add automated alert if signature failures > 10 in 5m for /webhooks/netsuite, (b) keep previous secret available for 24h, (c) add integration test simulating secret rotation, (d) treat 409 as idempotent.

Rosa (Ops): Added alert and Slack escalation to #eng-oncall. Also added a checklist step to notify Payments and Finance when rotating webhook secrets.

billing-bot: RESOLVED: webhook delivery spike subsided 02:24 UTC. Monitoring until 03:00 UTC.
